body: On the back: “the first morning, a medicinal odor in the cab after the experimental seed run. my throat tightened. The seedlings along the verge had blackened.”
title: Cab note — the first morning

body: A worker drew a chalk circle around the stopped car and promised a tow after the next convoy. The convoy arrived, took everyone able to walk, and crossed our names off his pad. I stayed to finish the tire and found the pad discarded.
title: Tire chalk
